## R-TVUI vX.Y.Z

**Download (recommended):** https://r-tvui-web.vercel.app/download  
**Docs:** https://r-tvui-web.vercel.app · **Source:** https://github.com/dfunani/r_tvui

### Install

**macOS / Linux**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dfunani/r_tvui/master/scripts/install.sh | bash
```

Pin version: `RTVUI_VERSION=X.Y.Z curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dfunani/r_tvui/master/scripts/install.sh | bash`

**Windows / manual:** use the platform table on the [download page](https://r-tvui-web.vercel.app/download).
